name: Modules.CoreMotion.MotionActivity
summary: Allows Titanium client applications to access CoreMotion's MotionActivity APIs.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.summary: Returns a Boolean indicating whether motion activity data is available on the current device.

methods.name: queryActivity
methods.summary: Gathers and returns historical motion activity data for the specified time period.
methods.description:
This method runs asynchronously, returning immediately and delivering the results 
to the specified callback. The system stores only the last seven days worth of 
activity data at most. If there are no samples for the specified range of time, 
an error object with the code [Modules.CoreMotion.ERROR_UNKNOWN](api:Modules.CoreMotion#ERROR_UNKNOWN) is passed to the 
callback.

inlined.name: CoreMotionQueryActivityArgs
inlined.summary: Dictionary of arguments to pass to the [MotionActivity.queryActivity()](api:Modules.CoreMotion.MotionActivity#queryActivity) method.

properties.name: end
properties.summary: The end time to use when gathering motion data.

properties.name: start
properties.summary: The start time to use when gathering motion data.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: The callback to execute with the results.

inlined.name: CoreMotionActivityQueryDataWithSuccess
inlined.summary: Dictionary passed to the callback of the [MotionActivity.queryActivity()](api:Modules.CoreMotion.MotionActivity#queryActivity) method.

properties.name: code
properties.summary: An error code describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: An error message describing the error if there was one.

properties.name: success
properties.summary: A Boolean indicating if the operation was successful or not.

methods.name: startActivityUpdates
methods.summary: Starts the delivery of current motion activity updates to your app.
methods.description:
This method initiates the tracking of motion data asynchronously. 
Upon calling this method, the motion activity manager executes the 
callback, reporting the current motion in effect for the device. 
After that, the motion activity manager executes the callback only 
when the motion data changes.

The callback is executed on a best effort basis and updates are not 
delivered while your app is suspended. If updates arrived while your 
app was suspended, the last update is delivered to your app when it 
resumes execution. To get all of the updates that occurred while your 
app was suspended, use the [Modules.CoreMotion.MotionActivity.queryActivity](api:Modules.CoreMotion.MotionActivity#queryActivity) method.

Upon starting activity updates, the motion activity manager reports 
changes to its callback until you call the [Modules.CoreMotion.MotionActivity.stopActivityUpdates](api:Modules.CoreMotion.MotionActivity#stopActivityUpdates) 
method. If you call this method again with a new callback, the activity 
manager stops delivering updates to the old callback and delivers them 
to the new callback instead.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: The method to be called when there is an update.

inlined.name: CoreMotionActivityData
inlined.summary: Represents the current motion associated with the device.
inlined.description: Note that there is no timestamp property for this class.

properties.name: activity
properties.summary: The motion activity object that defines the current type of motion for the device.

methods.name: stopActivityUpdates
methods.summary: Stops the delivery of motion activity updates to your app.
